Implemented event-driven architecture with Apache Kafka, handling message production and consumption with validation, retry mechanisms, and failure handling to ensure reliable asynchronous processing .

Conducted comprehensive API testing using Postman (functional, performance, tests), ensuring reliability and uptime of critical RESTful services across the platform.
